tools.name: read_information
tools.description: Read published RegusciLabs information about the innovation lab, AI, hardware, POCs, discovery, cases, Newsroom or policies. No login needed.

tools.name: search_information
tools.description: Search public RegusciLabs content in Spanish or English. Returns source links and excerpts, not generated claims.

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: List the latest published RegusciLabs Newsroom articles and El Pulso editions, newest first. Filter by language and source; return canonical URLs, dates, source citations and nextCursor. This is a read-only public archive, not a live breaking-news feed.

tools.name: get_latest_activity
tools.description: Browse curated public RegusciLabs social posts with real post URLs, platform, language, topic and verified-date filters and pagination. Not a real-time feed; unverified post dates are null and platforms without approved sources may be empty.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Send a project idea to RegusciLabs to start discovery. Requires the person's explicit approval and contact details. Validate with dryRun:true first. Does not subscribe the person. tools.name: subscribe_pulse
tools.description: Subscribe a person to The Pulse by email with their explicit newsletter consent and chosen format, frequency and language. Validate with dryRun:true first. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_latest_news, get_latest_activity · Private data: submit_inquiry · Public sink: get_latest_activity, submit_inquiry, subscribe_pulse · Destructive: subscribe_pulse.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_latest_news, get_latest_activity · Private data: submit_inquiry · Public sink: get_latest_activity, submit_inquiry, subscribe_pulse · Destructive: subscribe_pulse

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
